propositions: complexity-baseline.json lacks CI enforcement against changes, unlike module-size-limit.txt which is locked against main in _build-and-test.yml
new baseline entries can be added to complexity-baseline.json without triggering the gate, because the test only validates count matching and schema but does not prevent entry growth
the module-size-limit lock fails open on git fetch errors, allowing unverified limit values from the current branch to be used instead of the main baseline
complexity-baseline.json gate must semantically compare against main: REJECT raised ceilings or added entries, ALLOW removed entries or lowered ceilings, and FAIL CLOSED on fetch errors
adding a new high-complexity function with a matching baseline entry in the same change must fail CI until the entry count policy is enforced
